notes.title: Balancing And Quality of Life Update Soon
notes.notes:
Updates Planned for 8/4/2024 

Balancing

 decreased health scaling of all zombies
 exploding zombies don't explode if you kill them (only if they finish their detonation animation)
 exploding zombies will not spawn on top of you
 acid zombie range reduced
 acid zombie projectile travel distance reduced
 reduced the cost of doors
 increased mp7 damage
 police and boss explosive resists decreased significantly


Quality of Life

 you will automatically reload if shooting with an empty clip (and have bullets in reserve)
 added more ammo buy stations
 the map on the start screen shows were ammo buys are
 decreased the rate at which ammo price increases
 the map on the start screen shows were you spawn
 added toggle in display settings to turn off muzzle flash light effect
 added player log to show when the max window repair limit is reached for the round



Bugs

 buying ammo with no weapon doesn't crash the game


Note: I would have pushed this update today but steam locked my account for 72 hours because i signed in with my phone for the first time....ːsteamsaltyː
